title: ScarletPitch

organization.text: Hosted by the Innovation, Design, and Entrepreneurship Academy (IDEA), ScarletPitch is a campus-wide pitch competition that celebrates student entrepreneurship. It brings together students from all disciplines and backgrounds to create businesses designed to be a force for good. Compete for cash and prizes, gain mentorship and visibility, and advance to UPitchNJ or the Hult Prize, all while connecting to Rutgers' vibrant entrepreneurial ecosystem. All ideas welcome!
